name: Fishmonger
subject_description: An adult Scottish man in his 40s to 50s (2012, coastal fishing village), average build, pale-to-ruddy weathered skin, short greying hair, wearing a waterproof bib-front oilskin apron in dark navy or dull yellow over a plain wool jumper, dark work trousers, black rubber wellington boots, no company logo or readable text anywhere. The natural-setting pose shows him standing beside his small refrigerated delivery van on a damp coastal village street under overcast midday light.

extra_panels.title: Startled reaction
extra_panels.description: the fishmonger half-stepped back with one hand raised instinctively in front of him, eyes wide, a startled expression, as if he has just opened a door onto something unexpected
